name: UGREEN
description: Shows a UGREEN NAS (UGOS or UGOS Pro) as a host with its Docker containers as guests: state, image and published ports. UGREEN has no public API: this uses the web API of the UGOS web page itself (port 9443), as documented by the community, so a firmware update can change it. Read-only; the password is encrypted with the NAS' own public key before it is sent.
author: Netlens
supports: UGOS / UGOS Pro (community-documented web API, confirmed there on a DH4300 Plus; simulator only here, not tested on a real UGREEN)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
